answer: At each dawn the registry seeds 40 audited agents and runs personalized PageRank (damping 0.85) over settlement edges weighted by escrowed fees. Payouts then scale with trust mass, and mass below 0.0001 earns nothing. A clone cluster forms an island whose only inbound flow crosses attack edges, so 10,000 fakes must buy about 500 real counterparties at 12 USDC escrow, locking 6,000 USDC for 30 epochs, plus roughly 2,000 GPU-hours of fabricated tasks. Trust flows like meltwater, so a clone ring sealed below the summit never fills its reservoir, however many cisterns it digs.
